title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,151–2,200 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Travel influencers share stunning photos of hidden gems in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 旅遊網紅在網路上分享許多台灣鮮為人知的絕美秘境照片。

examples.en: Brands often collaborate with micro-influencers to target niche markets.
examples.zh: 品牌經常與微網紅合作，以精準鎖定利基市場。

examples.en: The beauty influencer posted a video demonstrating her morning skincare routine.
examples.zh: 這位美妝網紅發布了一支影片示範她的早晨護膚流程。

examples.en: Content creators spend hours editing videos to entertain audiences.
examples.zh: 內容創作者花費數小時精心剪輯影片以娛樂觀眾。

examples.en: Becoming a full-time content creator requires persistence and creativity.
examples.zh: 成為全職內容創作者需要極大的堅持與源源不絕的創意。

examples.en: The workshop teaches aspiring content creators how to pitch brand deals.
examples.zh: 這場工作坊教導有抱負的創作者如何洽談品牌商業合作。

examples.en: The YouTube channel celebrated reaching one million subscribers.
examples.zh: 該 YouTube 頻道盛大慶祝訂閱人數突破百萬大關。

examples.en: Paid subscribers receive access to exclusive behind-the-scenes footage.
examples.zh: 付費訂閱會員可享有專屬幕後花絮的觀看權限。

examples.en: Magazine subscribers enjoy home delivery every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 該雜誌訂閱戶每週一早晨都能收到專人送府的刊物。

words.definition: 訂閱；訂閱服務；定期捐助

examples.en: Monthly music streaming subscriptions offer ad-free unlimited listening.
examples.zh: 每月的音樂串流訂閱服務提供無廣告的無限暢聽享受。

examples.en: You can cancel your gym subscription at any time without extra fees.
examples.zh: 你可以隨時取消健身房會籍訂閱，無需支付任何手續費。

examples.en: The news website adopted a paid subscription model for premium articles.
examples.zh: 該新聞網站對深度優質文章採取了付費訂閱模式。

examples.en: She gained thousands of new Instagram followers after the viral reel.
examples.zh: 在那支短影音爆紅後，她的 IG 暴增了數千名新粉絲。

examples.en: The chef shares quick weekly dinner recipes with his loyal followers.
examples.zh: 這位大廚每週與他忠實的粉絲追隨者分享快手晚餐食譜。

examples.en: Having millions of followers does not always translate into high sales.
examples.zh: 擁有數百萬名追隨者並不總是能直接轉化為高額銷售額。

examples.en: High audience engagement proves that the video resonated with viewers.
examples.zh: 高觀眾互動率證明了該影片引起了閱聽大眾的深刻共鳴。

examples.en: Replying to comments under your posts significantly boosts user engagement.
examples.zh: 在貼文底下回覆留言能顯著提升使用者的互動參與度。

examples.en: They happily announced their wedding engagement to close family members.
examples.zh: 他們滿心歡喜地向至親家人宣布了兩人訂婚的喜訊。

words.definition: 爆紅的；病毒式傳播的；病毒的

examples.en: The funny Taiwanese pet video went viral globally within forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 那支逗趣的台灣寵物影片在四十八小時內在全球網路上瘋傳爆紅。

examples.en: Catchy dance challenges tend to go viral quickly on TikTok.
examples.zh: 旋律洗腦的舞蹈挑戰往往能在 TikTok 上迅速掀起病毒式風潮。

examples.en: The marketing campaign achieved viral reach through clever memes.
examples.zh: 該行銷專案透過巧妙的迷因梗圖達到了現象級的病毒傳播效應。

examples.en: Check the YouTube trending tab to discover popular music releases.
examples.zh: 查看 YouTube 發燒影片榜單以探索最新熱門音樂發行。

examples.en: The hashtag related to the solar eclipse became trending worldwide.
examples.zh: 與日食相關的主題標籤迅速登上全球熱門發燒趨勢。

examples.en: Fashion retailers quickly stock up on trending autumn styles.
examples.zh: 快時尚零售商迅速進貨上架最熱門流行的秋季款式。

examples.en: Turn on the bell notification to get immediate updates on new uploads.
examples.zh: 開啟小鈴鐺推播通知以獲取最新上片的第一手即時資訊。

examples.en: I disabled social media notifications while studying for my exam.
examples.zh: 準備考試期間，我關閉了所有社群媒體的推播通知。

examples.en: You will receive an SMS notification once your package arrives at the convenience store.
examples.zh: 一旦包裹抵達便利商店，您就會收到簡訊取貨通知。

examples.en: The indie band will livestream their acoustic concert tonight.
examples.zh: 這支獨立樂團將於今晚線上直播他們的不插電演唱會。

examples.en: Over ten thousand people tuned in to watch the SpaceX rocket launch livestream.
examples.zh: 超過一萬人上線同步收看了 SpaceX 火箭升空的現場直播。

examples.en: She often livestreams her pottery making sessions on Sunday mornings.
examples.zh: 她經常在週日早晨開直播展示她的陶藝製作過程。

examples.en: The popular gaming streamer interacts warmly with fans via live chat.
examples.zh: 這位人氣遊戲實況主透過即時聊天室與粉絲熱情互動。

examples.en: Full-time streamers rely on viewer donations and brand sponsorships.
examples.zh: 全職實況主主要依靠觀眾抖內贊助與品牌贊助為生。

examples.en: Colorful paper streamers decorated the birthday party hall.
examples.zh: 五顏六色的彩帶將生日派對會場裝點得喜氣洋洋。

examples.en: Over fifty thousand live viewers watched the esports grand final.
examples.zh: 超過五萬名線上觀眾同步收看了這場電競總決賽。

examples.en: The film director captured the majestic landscape from a bird's-eye viewer angle.
examples.zh: 電影導演以鳥瞰觀眾視角捕捉了雄偉壯麗的自然景觀。

examples.en: TV viewers voted for their favorite singing contestants via a mobile app.
examples.zh: 電視觀眾透過手機應用程式為心儀的歌唱選手投票。

examples.en: Don't forget to like, share, and leave a comment below!
examples.zh: 別忘了按讚、分享，並在下方留言處留下您的看法！

examples.en: The spokesperson declined to make any comment regarding the rumors.
examples.zh: 發言人拒絕對外界的謠傳發表任何評論。

examples.en: Her critical comments helped improve the team's research paper.
examples.zh: 她切中要點的評論建議幫助團隊改進了研究論文品質。

examples.en: Fans actively reposted the celebrity's charity appeal on Threads.
examples.zh: 粉絲們在 Threads 上熱心轉發了這位名人的慈善公益呼籲。

examples.en: Please ask for permission before you repost original artwork online.
examples.zh: 在轉發網路上的原創藝術作品前，請先徵得原作者授權。

examples.en: The cooking video received thousands of reposts within an hour.
examples.zh: 這支烹飪教學影片在一小時之內就獲得了數千次轉發分享。

examples.en: Use descriptive hashtags like #TaiwanTravel to increase post visibility.
examples.zh: 使用 #TaiwanTravel 等主題標籤能大幅增加貼文的曝光度。

examples.en: The protest movement organized rallies around a unified social media hashtag.
examples.zh: 該倡議抗議運動圍繞著一個統一的社群標籤組織起集會活動。

examples.en: Avoid cluttering your captions with dozens of irrelevant hashtags.
examples.zh: 避免在文字說明欄堆疊數十個毫無關聯的主題標籤。

examples.en: A bright, eye-catching thumbnail attracts higher video click-through rates.
examples.zh: 明亮吸睛的封面縮圖能帶來更高的影片點閱率。

examples.en: Graphic designers use bold typography and expressive faces in YouTube thumbnails.
examples.zh: 平面設計師會在 YouTube 封面縮圖中使用鮮明文字與誇張表情。

examples.en: Click any photo thumbnail in the gallery to expand it to full size.
examples.zh: 點選相簿中任何照片縮圖即可放大檢視完整尺寸。

examples.en: She uploaded a daily food vlog exploring Tainan traditional breakfasts.
examples.zh: 她上傳了一支探索台南道地傳統早餐的一日美食 Vlog。

examples.en: The couple recorded a travel vlog documenting their backpacking trip across Europe.
examples.zh: 這對情侶錄製了一支旅遊 Vlog，記錄他們橫跨歐洲的背包客旅程。

examples.en: Editing a twenty-minute video vlog takes nearly eight hours of post-production.
examples.zh: 剪輯一支二十分鐘的影音 Vlog 需要花費近八小時的後製時間。

examples.en: I love listening to English learning podcasts during my morning commute.
examples.zh: 我喜歡在早晨通勤途中收聽英語學習的 Podcast 節目。

examples.en: The tech podcast features weekly discussions on semiconductor trends.
examples.zh: 這個科技播客節目每週深度探討半導體產業發展趨勢。

examples.en: They set up soundproof acoustic panels to record their new podcast series.
examples.zh: 他們架設了專業吸音隔音板來錄製全新的播客節目系列。

examples.en: The charismatic podcast host interviewed a renowned movie director.
examples.zh: 魅力十足的播客主持人專訪了一位知名電影導演。

examples.en: Taipei was chosen to host the international technology convention next year.
examples.zh: 台北獲選為主辦明年國際科技盛會的東道主城市。

examples.en: The gracious party host ensured every guest had drinks and appetizers.
examples.zh: 熱情好客的派對主人確保每位賓客都有充足的飲品與開胃小點。

examples.en: The season finale episode left viewers in tears and wonder.
examples.zh: 本季完結篇的那一集讓所有觀眾感動落淚且回味無窮。

examples.en: In yesterday's episode, the main characters finally reconciled after years of silence.
examples.zh: 在昨天的單集劇情中，主角們在多年沉默後終於解開心結言歸於好。

examples.en: Download your favorite podcast episodes so you can listen offline on flights.
examples.zh: 先下載好喜愛的播客單集，在搭機飛行時就能離線收聽。

examples.en: Netflix announced that season two of the sci-fi drama is coming.
examples.zh: Netflix 宣布這部熱門科幻影集的第二季即將上線。

examples.en: Autumn is the best season to go hiking in the Taiwanese mountains.
examples.zh: 秋天是造訪台灣壯麗高山健行登山的最佳季節。

examples.en: The basketball team had an undefeated record throughout the regular season.
examples.zh: 這支籃球隊在整個例行賽季期間保持著全勝不敗紀錄。

words.definition: 變現；營利；將…轉化為收入

examples.en: Creators can monetize their channels through memberships and digital merch.
examples.zh: 創作者可透過頻道會員與數位周邊商品來實現流量變現。

examples.en: The startup found a clever way to monetize its free mobile application.
examples.zh: 這家新創團隊找到了一種巧妙為其免費 App 變現的商業模式。

examples.en: Many hobby bloggers eventually learn how to monetize their site through affiliate links.
examples.zh: 許多業餘部落客最終學會了如何透過聯盟行銷連結將網站流量變現。

examples.en: In-stream advertising provides a steady stream of content monetization.
examples.zh: 影片插播廣告為內容創作提供了穩定的變現營利來源。

examples.en: The game developer explored alternative monetization strategies that avoid pay-to-win mechanics.
examples.zh: 該遊戲開發商探索了避免「花錢獲勝」機制的替代營利模式。

examples.en: Platforms have lowered the entry threshold for channel monetization.
examples.zh: 影音平台降低了創作者開通頻道營利變現的門檻標準。

examples.en: Online video platforms share ad revenue with eligible video creators.
examples.zh: 影音平台會與符合資格的創作者拆分廣告分潤收益。

examples.en: The tech giant reported record quarterly revenue driven by cloud services.
examples.zh: 該科技巨頭在雲端業務強勁帶動下繳出了創紀錄的季度營收成績。

examples.en: Municipal governments generate tax revenue from property and sales taxes.
examples.zh: 市政府主要透過房屋稅與營業銷售稅來獲取財政稅收。

examples.en: Always use royalty-free background music to avoid copyright strikes.
examples.zh: 務必使用免版稅背景音樂以避免觸犯版權警告。

examples.en: The author holds the international copyright to all her published novels.
examples.zh: 該作家對其名下出版的所有長篇小說享有國際著作權。

examples.en: Unauthorized distribution of movie torrents is a clear violation of copyright law.
examples.zh: 未經授權散布電影種子檔案是公然違反著作權法的侵權行為。

examples.en: Songwriters receive monthly royalties whenever their music is streamed.
examples.zh: 每當歌曲被串流播放時，詞曲創作者都能收到相應的版稅收入。

examples.en: Authors usually earn a percentage of book royalties on every copy sold.
examples.zh: 作家每賣出一本書通常可獲得一定比例的版稅抽成。

examples.en: British royalty attended the solemn memorial service at the cathedral.
examples.zh: 英國王室成員出席了大教堂舉行的莊嚴追思儀式。

examples.en: Today's video episode is sponsored by an innovative language learning app.
examples.zh: 今天的影片節目由一款創新的語言學習 App 贊助播出。

examples.en: A multinational beverage brand agreed to sponsor the international marathon.
examples.zh: 一家跨國飲料品牌同意贊助這場大規模國際馬拉松賽事。

examples.en: The charity gala seeks corporate sponsors to fund scholarships for disadvantaged students.
examples.zh: 這場慈善晚會尋求企業贊助商為弱勢清寒學子提供獎助學金。

examples.en: Two popular Taiwanese YouTubers collaborated on an epic cooking challenge.
examples.zh: 兩位人氣台灣 YouTuber 聯手合作拍攝了一場史詩級的料理挑戰。

examples.en: Scientists from five different countries collaborated to sequence the rare plant genome.
examples.zh: 來自五個國家的科學家攜手合作完成了珍稀植物的基因定序。

examples.en: Graphic designers and copywriters must collaborate closely on advertising campaigns.
examples.zh: 平面設計師與廣告文案撰稿人必須在廣告專案中緊密協同合作。

examples.en: Tech fans eagerly watched the unboxing video of the newest flagship smartphone.
examples.zh: 科技迷們熱切觀看最新款旗艦智慧型手機的實體開箱影片。

examples.en: The toy collector posted a live unboxing of rare vintage action figures.
examples.zh: 這位玩具收藏家直播開箱了極其珍貴的絕版復古公仔手辦。

examples.en: Unboxing videos offer potential buyers an authentic first impression of package contents.
examples.zh: 開箱影片為潛在買家提供了包裝內含物的真實第一手開箱印象。

examples.en: Read honest gadget reviews before deciding which tablet to buy.
examples.zh: 在決定購買哪款平板電腦之前，先閱讀客觀真實的評測心得。

examples.en: The academic committee conducted a thorough review of the research proposal.
examples.zh: 學術委員會對該項專題研究企劃書進行了極其嚴謹的審查評估。

examples.en: Students gathered at the library to review vocabulary notes before the midterm.
examples.zh: 學生們期中考前聚集在圖書館內溫習複習單字筆記。

words.definition: 教學指南；自學影片課程

examples.en: Follow this step-by-step video tutorial to learn photo editing skills.
examples.zh: 跟著這部逐步教學指南影片來學習實用的修圖技巧。

examples.en: The coding platform includes interactive tutorials for total beginners.
examples.zh: 該程式設計學習平台為零基礎初學者提供了互動式教學課程。

examples.en: She published an online tutorial showing how to knit woolen winter scarves.
examples.zh: 她在網路上發布了一篇教人如何編織保暖羊毛圍巾的手作教學指南。

examples.en: Streaming platforms transformed how global audiences consume movies.
examples.zh: 影音串流平台徹底改變了全球觀眾觀看電影與影集的習慣。

examples.en: Several competing streaming platforms now bid millions for exclusive broadcast rights.
examples.zh: 數家競爭的串流平台如今豪擲重金競標熱門節目的獨家播映權。

examples.en: You can download shows directly from the streaming platform for offline travel viewing.
examples.zh: 你可以直接從串流平台上預先下載影集，方便旅途離線觀看。

examples.en: I stayed up late to binge-watch the entire Taiwanese mystery series.
examples.zh: 我熬夜狂追，一口氣把整部台灣懸疑推理台劇看完了。

examples.en: Rainy weekends are ideal for curling up on the sofa and binge-watching comedies.
examples.zh: 陰雨連綿的週末最適合窩在沙發上連續追看爆笑喜劇影集。

examples.en: Many people binge-watch new shows in a single weekend instead of waiting weekly.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡在一個週末內一口氣追完整部新劇，而不想苦等每週更新。

words.definition: 懸念；吊胃口的刺激結尾

examples.en: The mystery episode ended on a shocking cliffhanger!
examples.zh: 這集懸疑劇在令人震撼且吊足胃口的懸念中戛然而止！

examples.en: Authors use clever cliffhangers at the end of chapters to keep readers turning pages.
examples.zh: 作家在章節結尾處巧妙埋下懸念鉤子，讓讀者欲罷不能地讀下去。

examples.en: The election was a nail-biting cliffhanger right up until the final ballot count.
examples.zh: 這場選戰一路緊張膠著，直到最後一張選票開完前都勝負懸殊難料。

examples.en: Spoiler alert: don't scroll social media if you haven't watched the finale!
examples.zh: 劇透警告：如果你還沒看大結局，請千萬別滑社群媒體！

examples.en: He accidentally revealed a major movie spoiler during our lunch conversation.
examples.zh: 他在我們吃午餐聊天時不小心劇透爆雷了電影的核心關鍵劇情。

examples.en: Online forums often use spoiler tags to protect fans from ruined surprises.
examples.zh: 網路討論區通常會使用防雷劇透遮罩標籤，以免毀了粉絲的驚喜。

examples.en: Stars walked the red carpet at the grand international movie premiere.
examples.zh: 眾多明星走上紅毯盛大出席國際電影首映典禮。

examples.en: The new fantasy drama will premiere on Friday night at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 這部全新奇幻影集將於週五晚間八點準時進行全球首播。

examples.en: Critics praised the director's bold narrative choices during the film premiere.
examples.zh: 影評人在電影首映會上對導演大膽前衛的敘事手法讚譽有加。

examples.en: Turning on English subtitles helps learners improve listening comprehension.
examples.zh: 開啟英文字幕能有效幫助英語學習者增進聽力理解能力。

examples.en: The foreign film was screened with dual traditional Chinese and English subtitles.
examples.zh: 這部外語電影放映時配上了繁體中文與英文雙語對照字幕。

examples.en: The book has an informative subtitle explaining its practical application.
examples.zh: 這本書帶有一個深具說明性的副標題，闡明了其具體的實務應用。

words.definition: 圖說；隱藏字幕 (CC)；說明文字

examples.en: Write a witty caption for your travel photo on Instagram.
examples.zh: 在 Instagram 上為你的旅遊風景美照寫一段幽默有趣的圖說。

examples.en: Closed captions make televised news accessible to hearing-impaired viewers.
examples.zh: 隱藏式字幕讓聽障觀眾也能順暢無礙地接收電視新聞資訊。

examples.en: The historical photo caption detailed the exact date and location of the signing.
examples.zh: 這張歷史老照片下方的圖說清楚標註了簽約的確切日期與歷史地點。

examples.en: The famous Japanese animation was dubbed into fluent Mandarin.
examples.zh: 這部著名的日本經典動畫被專業配音為流利的國語版本。

examples.en: Some foreign films lose nuances when they are dubbed rather than subtitled.
examples.zh: 某些外語電影在經過語音配音後，往往不如原音搭配字幕來得傳神細膩。

examples.en: The media dubbed him the fastest runner in high school track history.
examples.zh: 媒體讚譽封他為高中田徑史上跑得最快的天才飛人。

examples.en: Talented voice actors breathe life and emotion into anime characters.
examples.zh: 才華洋溢的專業配音員賦予了動漫角色生動的情感與靈魂。

examples.en: She auditioned for a competitive voice actor role in a Pixar animation.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了皮克斯動畫電影一場競爭極為激烈的配音員角色甄選。

examples.en: A successful voice actor can alter tone, accent, and pitch effortlessly.
examples.zh: 優秀成功的配音員能游刃有餘地切換調整自己的語氣、口音與音高。

examples.en: Spectacular computer visual effects brought mythical creatures to life.
examples.zh: 炫目震撼的電腦視覺特效讓神話生物活靈活現地躍然銀幕上。

examples.en: The sci-fi movie earned an Academy Award nomination for Best Visual Effects.
examples.zh: 這部科幻鉅作榮獲了奧斯卡最佳視覺特效獎的提名肯定。

examples.en: Independent film creators leverage accessible 3D software to produce indie visual effects.
examples.zh: 獨立電影製作者善用平易近人的 3D 軟體也能打造出高質感的視覺特效。

examples.en: Taiwanese 3D animation studios have won prestigious international film awards.
examples.zh: 台灣本土的 3D 動畫團隊榮獲了多座國際知名影展大獎。

examples.en: The graphic designer added subtle UI button animations to make the app feel alive.
examples.zh: 介面設計師加入了細膩的按鈕微動畫，讓這款 App 充滿生動的互動感。

examples.en: Traditional hand-drawn 2D animation requires immense patience and craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 傳統手繪 2D 動畫需要極大的耐心與極致扎實的手藝技術。

examples.en: Wearing a VR headset immerses users in interactive 360-degree worlds.
examples.zh: 戴上 VR 頭戴式顯示器能讓使用者完全沉浸在 360 度互動世界中。

examples.en: Flight training schools utilize virtual reality simulators to train student pilots safely.
examples.zh: 飛行駕訓學校利用虛擬實境模擬機安全高效地培訓學員飛行員。

examples.en: Medical students practice complex surgical techniques using virtual reality equipment.
examples.zh: 醫學生運用先進的虛擬實境設備反覆模擬練習複雜的外科手術操作。

examples.en: Mobile AR games blend digital gaming graphics with the real environment.
examples.zh: 手機 AR 遊戲將數位圖像元素無縫疊加於真實環境中。

examples.en: Furniture retail apps use augmented reality to let customers visualize sofas at home.
examples.zh: 家具零售 App 運用擴增實境技術讓顧客在家中虛擬預覽沙發擺設效果。

examples.en: Museum visitors engaged with historical relics via interactive augmented reality glasses.
examples.zh: 博物館參觀者透過佩戴互動式 AR 眼鏡，親身感受歷史文物的生動講解。

examples.en: Virtual concerts and avatars thrive inside the expansive metaverse.
examples.zh: 虛擬演唱會與數位虛擬化身在廣袤的元宇宙中蓬勃發展。

examples.en: Global tech companies invest billions to develop interoperable metaverse platforms.
examples.zh: 全球科技大廠斥資數十億美元打造可互通運作的元宇宙平台生態系。

examples.en: Users can socialize, work, and purchase digital assets in the metaverse.
examples.zh: 用戶能在元宇宙虛擬空間中進行社交互動、協同辦公並購買數位資產。

examples.en: Professional esports tournaments fill massive indoor stadiums worldwide.
examples.zh: 職業電競錦標賽在世界各地的巨型室內體育館座無虛席。

examples.en: Becoming an esports champion requires lightning reflexes and intense teamwork.
examples.zh: 成為電競世界冠軍需要具備如閃電般的敏銳反應與緊密無間的團隊配合。

examples.en: Universities now offer athletic scholarships for elite esports players.
examples.zh: 許多知名大學現在也針對頂尖電競選手頒發專屬的體育獎學金。

examples.en: Understanding how the platform algorithm works helps boost video impressions.
examples.zh: 深入了解平台演算法推薦機制有助於大幅提升影片曝光觸及率。

examples.en: Streaming services recommend songs using collaborative filtering algorithms.
examples.zh: 音樂串流服務透過協同過濾演算法向聽眾精準推薦喜愛的曲目。

examples.en: Tech companies continuously tweak search algorithms to fight disinformation.
examples.zh: 科技公司持續微調優化搜尋演算法以積極打擊不實假訊息傳播。

examples.en: Scroll down your news feed to discover trending stories and friends' updates.
examples.zh: 向下滑動你的社群動態牆以探索熱門話題與好友最新動態。

examples.en: Farmers wake up at dawn to feed livestock in the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫們黎明時分就早早起床到牲口棚舍裡餵食牲畜家禽。

examples.en: The RSS feed automatically pulls fresh news articles into the reader app.
examples.zh: RSS 資訊摘要源能自動將最新出版的新聞文章抓取至閱讀器中。

examples.en: Viewers can buy featured snacks instantly during interactive livestream shopping.
examples.zh: 觀眾在互動式的直播帶貨過程中能即時搶購下單特色零食。

examples.en: Livestream shopping generated billions in revenue during the holiday e-commerce festival.
examples.zh: 直播帶貨在節慶電商狂歡購物節期間創造了數以十億計的驚人營收。

examples.en: Hosts offer limited-time discounts to create urgency in livestream shopping sessions.
examples.zh: 直播主在帶貨直播現場祭出限時折扣優惠，以營造搶購的緊迫感。

examples.en: Cultivating a supportive fan community is essential for long-term creator success.
examples.zh: 經營一個溫馨互助的粉絲社群是創作者維持長期成功的重要基石。

examples.en: The neighborhood community banded together to clean up the coastal beach.
examples.zh: 社區鄰里團結一心，攜手同心投入清理沿海沙灘垃圾的環保行動。

examples.en: Developers contribute code openly to benefit the global open-source community.
examples.zh: 開發者們無私公開貢獻程式碼，造福全球廣大的開源軟體社群。
